# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (Jan 9, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing the `op-deployer` with new game type management, improving system stability by allowing dynamic port assignments, and upgrading `op-geth` to v1.16.5. Significant work was also done on validating EIP-1559 parameters and applying timeouts to HTTP requests in `op-challenger`.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Enhanced Deployment and Game Type Management
The `op-deployer` now includes a new command, `add-game-type-opcm-v2`, which streamlines the process of adding new game types to chains utilizing OPContractsManager V2. This feature acts as a wrapper around the existing upgrade command, simplifying contract management. ([#18660](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18660))

### System Stability and Port Management Improvements
To mitigate port collision issues within `sysgo`, updates were made to `op_rbuilder`, `opreth`, and `rollup-boost`. These changes allow the operating system to dynamically assign ports by default, enhancing system stability and reducing conflicts. ([#18739](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18739))

### Core Infrastructure Upgrades and Validation
The `op-geth` component has been upgraded to upstream version v1.16.5, bringing the latest improvements and fixes. Additionally, redundant validation for EIP-1559 parameters (denominator and elasticity) was added to the derivation pipeline in `op-node`, providing defense-in-depth against contract-level checks. ([#18337](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18337), [#18638](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18638))

### Challenger Reliability Enhancements
The `op-challenger` now applies timeouts to HTTP requests, utilizing a custom RPC wrapper where possible. This change improves the reliability and robustness of the challenger by preventing indefinite waits for network responses. ([#18731](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18731))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- A new feature to add support for Interop Migration using OPCM v2 has been proposed. ([#18738](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18738))
- An update to chore: update fees depositor address and min withdrawal amounts has been submitted. ([#18736](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18736))

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Core Infrastructure Updates
The issue related to the `geth v1.16.5 upstream merge` has been closed, indicating the successful integration of the updated Geth client. ([#18218](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18218)) Additionally, the issue concerning the `op-node` check for zero elasticity multiplier in EIP-1559 parameters has been resolved. ([#18625](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18625))

### Acceptance Test Suite Refinements
Several acceptance tests related to `rollup-boost` and `rbuilder` failures, sequencer failover, and flashblocks HA failover have been closed. These issues were closed in favor of the understanding that they would require infrastructure manipulation, which was scoped out of `op-acceptance-tests`. ([#316](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/316), [#314](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/314), [#318](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/318), [#317](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/317), [#350](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/350))

### Load Testing Scope Adjustment
The acceptance test for `flashblocks: load tests` has been closed, with the rationale that it is now scoped under the Benchmarking Milestone for future nightly automations. ([#379](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/379))

## NEW ISSUES

### Kona Prestate Validation Simplification
A new issue has been opened to simplify the validation process for Kona prestates, outlining steps to clone the Kona repo and verify release tags. ([#18735](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18735))

### Blob Priority Fee Tracking for Batcher/Txmgr
A new issue proposes activating `op-batcher/txmgr` blob priority fee tracking. This includes reviewing current configurations, adding an activation changeset, and monitoring the new blob tip cap on production. ([#18737](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18737))

### Op-Supernode Interoperability and Reset Handling
Several new issues have been created to address `op-supernode` functionalities. These include defining `Reset Handling` for complex protocol driving ([#18740](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18740)), outlining the `Interop Implementation` as a sandbox for extending OP Nodes ([#18741](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18741)), specifying `Interop Application Behaviors` for chain interaction and result recording ([#18742](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18742)), and detailing the `Interop Algo` for log validation and invalid block exposure ([#18743](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18743)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Validation Checks on All Chains
Issue [#668](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/668), "Error running validation checks on all chains," was closed today by alfonso-op, stating that it is "No longer an issue." This indicates that the previously reported `concurrent map read and map write` errors during validation checks have been resolved.
